name: Guided Tours at Galeria Municipal
description: Join a guided tour of the gallery's three current exhibitions, including works by Leonor Parda and Augustas Serapinas.
longDescription:
The Galeria Municipal do Porto presents a series of guided tours, offering visitors a structured exploration of its current exhibition program. These tours are led by gallery staff or invited experts, providing context and insight into the artistic practices and themes presented. The initiative aims to deepen public engagement with contemporary art and the specific works on display, fostering a more informed appreciation of the gallery's curatorial vision.

Attendees will embark on a journey through three distinct exhibitions, gaining perspectives on the individual contributions of artists such as Leonor Parda and Augustas Serapinas. The tours are conducted in a conversational style, allowing for a focused examination of selected pieces and broader discussions about the artists' methodologies and conceptual frameworks. The Galeria Municipal, housed in a notable building, provides a spacious and contemplative environment for viewing art.

The guided tours are scheduled for May 2, 2026. Specific details regarding pricing are available upon inquiry. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is situated in an accessible area of the city, within walking distance of several public transport links.
